description:
Bycatch from the fz-kdt.107 cold review's Q1 probes (2026-09-01;
probes/q1a.fz, q1b.fz in session scratchpad rev107/probes/): a valid
program with two reduce calls over different element families sharing
an [] seed accumulator is REFUSED at compile time with spec/violation
-- the analysis conflates the two closures' parameter types. Valid
Elixir refused. Consequence beyond the bug itself: a whole family of
adversarial dispatch-twin programs (fz-kdt.107's Q1 shapes) is
UNWRITABLE today, which is part of why the corpus looks safe -- fixing
this may EXPOSE more of 107's class, so re-run the arm-reversal stress
after fixing.
title: Two reducers over different element families sharing an [] accumulator are rejected with a false spec/violation
